widget.name: Historical
widget.description: Get historical price data for a given stock. This includes open, high, low, close, and volume.

params.label: Symbol
params.description: Symbol to get data for. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Start Date
params.description: Start date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: End Date
params.description: End date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: Interval
params.description: Time interval of the data to return.

params.label: Exchange
params.description: EODHD exchange code appended to bare symbols (e.g. 'US', 'LSE', 'TO'). Ignored when the symbol is already qualified, like 'AAPL.US'.

params.label: Chart Source
params.description: Include acquisition evidence for bounded daily US prices.

columnsDefs.headerTooltip: Volume Weighted Average Price over the period.
